"""Preparation only after actual codec approval; no build/import/browser."""
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,shlex,stat,sys,tempfile,re,subprocess
repo=pathlib.Path('/workspace/StarShipSimulator')
research=repo/'docs/research/2026-10-04-cloud-resume'
owned=research/'render-kernel-compact-json-repair'
old=pathlib.Path('/tmp/starship-render-kernel.m9xok0x9')
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
checked_inputs={}
def regular(file):
    file=pathlib.Path(file)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(file.lstat().st_mode):raise RuntimeError('Symlink/special input '+str(file))
    return file.read_bytes()
def checked(file,pin):
    b=regular(file)
    if sha(b)!=pin:raise RuntimeError('Input drift '+str(file))
    checked_inputs[str(pathlib.Path(file))]=pin
    return b
def load(file):return json.loads(regular(file))
def put(file,b):
    with pathlib.Path(file).open('xb') as f:f.write(b)
def dump(file,value):put(file,(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
if len(sys.argv)!=3:raise SystemExit('Actual accepted codec approval + independent approval SHA required')
pin_bytes=regular(owned/'reuse-process-pin-repair-input-pins.json')
if sha(pin_bytes)!=os.environ.get('COMPACT_REUSE_INPUT_PINS_SHA256'):raise RuntimeError('Frozen reuse input map required')
for file,pin in json.loads(pin_bytes).items():checked(file,pin)
checked(__file__,sha(regular(owned/'prepare-reused-library-process-pin-repair.py.txt')))
codec_path=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);codec_sha=sys.argv[2]
codec= json.loads(checked(codec_path,codec_sha))
if codec.get('decision')!='ONE compact codec actual proof accepted; reused setup preparation only':raise RuntimeError('Fresh codec result approval required')
for file,pin in codec['inputs'].items():checked(file,pin)
for required in [codec['ownerResultPath'],codec['independentAbsencePath']]:
    if required not in codec['inputs']:raise RuntimeError('Unpinned codec authority '+required)
codec_result=load(codec['ownerResultPath'])
if not codec_result['finalized'] or codec_result['childCode']!=0 or codec_result['failure'] is not None or not codec_result['sourceExact']:raise RuntimeError('Actual codec proof failed')
if codec_result['before']!=codec_result['after']:raise RuntimeError('Codec inputs drift')
if not codec_result['absence'] or any(row['executing'] for row in codec_result['absence']):raise RuntimeError('Codec local absence failed')
proof_path=pathlib.Path(codec_result['setup'])/'proof-result.json'
proof_bytes=checked(proof_path,codec_result['proofResultSha256']);proof=json.loads(proof_bytes)
if not proof['finalized'] or len(proof['results'])!=6 or not all(row['passed'] for row in proof['results']) or proof['negativeControls']!=4:raise RuntimeError('Incomplete actual codec proof')
# Independent parent all-owned absence and actual process signal are separately pinned in codec inputs.
parent_absence=load(codec['independentAbsencePath'])
if parent_absence.get('verifiedOwnedAbsence') is not True:raise RuntimeError('Independent codec absence required')
process_key=codec['actualProcessPath']
process_path=pathlib.Path(process_key)
if process_path!=pathlib.Path(codec_result['setup'])/'codec.process.json':raise RuntimeError('Actual codec process path outside accepted setup')
if process_key not in codec['inputs']:raise RuntimeError('Actual codec process receipt missing mandatory digest input')
process=json.loads(checked(process_path,codec['inputs'][process_key]))
if process['exit']!={'code':0,'signal':None} or process['failure'] is not None or process['cleanup']['executing']:raise RuntimeError('Actual process termination invalid')
raw_manifest=checked(old/'kernel-compiled-manifest.json','00a30ff1e01222f6913a01e5e45838dedfc75e30d63b3cd22852c6702d36fa4f');manifest=json.loads(raw_manifest)
if len(manifest['files'])!=21 or len(manifest['sourceContents'])!=492 or manifest['unresolvedSources']:raise RuntimeError('Accepted library inventory differs')
for relative,pin in manifest['ownedSources']:checked(repo/relative,pin)
for item in manifest['sourceContents']:checked(repo/item['repositoryPath'],item['sha256'])
receipt=load(old/'setup-receipt.json')
# Full current source/CI/dist/proof tuple; no stale build qualification accepted by inference.
listed=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z','--cached','--others','--exclude-standard'],cwd=repo,timeout=5).decode().split('\0')
listed=sorted(p for p in listed if re.match(r'^(src/|tests/|scripts/|public/|\.agents/|\.nvmrc$|package[^/]*\.json$|[^/]*config\.[^/]+$)',p))
if listed!=[p for p,h in receipt['sourceManifest']]:raise RuntimeError('Current source inventory differs')
for relative,pin in receipt['sourceManifest']:
    file=repo/relative
    if pin is None:
        if file.exists() or file.is_symlink():raise RuntimeError('Recorded deleted source exists '+relative)
    else:checked(file,pin)
for relative,pin in receipt.get('additionalGithubFiles',[]):checked(repo/relative,pin)
for group in ['buildFiles','mapFiles']:
    for relative,pin in receipt[group]:checked(repo/'dist'/relative,pin)
actual_files=[]
for directory,dirs,files in os.walk(repo/'dist',followlinks=False):
    for name in dirs:
        if pathlib.Path(directory,name).is_symlink():raise RuntimeError('Dist symlink directory')
    for name in files:
        f=pathlib.Path(directory,name);regular(f);actual_files.append(str(f.relative_to(repo/'dist')))
actual_files.sort()
if actual_files!=sorted(p for g in ['buildFiles','mapFiles'] for p,h in receipt[g]):raise RuntimeError('Current dist inventory differs')
for item in receipt.get('physicsProofs',[]):
    if item['outcome']!='passed':raise RuntimeError('Old approved physics receipt failed')
    checked(repo/item['path'],item['sha256'])
for field,pin in [('nodeExecutable','nodeExecutableSha256'),('actualBrowser','actualBrowserSha256'),('originalBrowser','originalBrowserSha256'),('config','configSha256')]:checked(receipt[field],receipt[pin])
checked(old/'bundle-copy-manifest.json',receipt['bundleManifestSha256'])
# Preserve old failure and independent all10-owned supplemental absence as separate authorities.
failure_pins=load(research/'cloud-render-kernel-texture-repair-cap-failure-independent-pins.json')['rawReceiptPinsSmall']
for file,pin in failure_pins.items():checked(file,pin)
old_parent=load(research/'render-kernel-texture-repair-browser-parent/parent-result.json')
if old_parent['childExit']!=1 or old_parent['timeout'] or not old_parent['sourceExact']:raise RuntimeError('Old failure provenance differs')
if not load(old/'collection-status.json')['truncated']:raise RuntimeError('Old cap failure must remain red')
accepted=load(research/'cloud-render-kernel-texture-repair-actual-build-browser-approval.json')
if accepted['compiledManifestSha256']!=sha(raw_manifest) or accepted['setup']!=str(old):raise RuntimeError('Old accepted library binding differs')
# Current research new runner, controls, hook, setup template and existing owner are independently pinned.
runner=regular(owned/'run-render-kernel-compact-json.mjs.txt')
if sha(runner)!=proof['candidateSha256']:raise RuntimeError('New runner does not match accepted codec proof')
old_runner=checked(research/'run-render-kernel-texture-repair.mjs',proof['originalSha256'])
if runner!=old_runner.replace(b"JSON.stringify(value,null,2)",b"JSON.stringify(value)",1):raise RuntimeError('Non-formatting runner delta')
setup=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='starship-render-kernel.',dir='/tmp'));setup.chmod(0o700)
print(str(setup),flush=True)
try:
    (setup/'compiled').mkdir(mode=0o700)
    if len(setup.parts)!=len(old.parts):raise RuntimeError('Source map depth changed')
    expected=sorted(manifest['files']);found=[]
    for file in (old/'compiled').rglob('*'):
        if file.is_dir():
            if file.is_symlink():raise RuntimeError('Old compiled symlink directory')
        else:found.append([str(file.relative_to(old/'compiled')),sha(regular(file))])
    if sorted(found)!=expected:raise RuntimeError('Old compiled bytes/set drift')
    for relative,pin in expected:
        src=old/'compiled'/relative;dst=setup/'compiled'/relative
        if '..' in pathlib.PurePosixPath(relative).parts or pathlib.PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute():raise RuntimeError('Unsafe compiled path')
        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);put(dst,checked(src,pin));checked(dst,pin)
    maps=[relative for relative,pin in expected if relative.endswith('.map')]
    if len(maps)!=10:raise RuntimeError('Expected ten maps')
    source_rows=[]
    for relative in maps:
        map_file=setup/'compiled'/relative;mapping=load(map_file)
        if mapping.get('sourceRoot') not in [None,'']:raise RuntimeError('Unreviewed map sourceRoot')
        if len(mapping['sources'])!=len(mapping['sourcesContent']):raise RuntimeError('Incomplete sourceContent')
        for source,content in zip(mapping['sources'],mapping['sourcesContent']):
            if not isinstance(content,str) or '://' in source:raise RuntimeError('External/missing map source')
            resolved=(map_file.parent/source).resolve();expected_source=(old/'compiled'/pathlib.Path(relative).parent/source).resolve()
            if resolved!=expected_source or not resolved.is_relative_to(repo):raise RuntimeError('Copied map resolves elsewhere')
            digest=sha(content.encode());checked(resolved,digest)
            source_rows.append({'map':'compiled/'+relative,'source':source,'repositoryPath':str(resolved.relative_to(repo)),'sha256':digest})
    order=lambda row:(row['map'],row['source'],row['repositoryPath'],row['sha256'])
    if sorted(source_rows,key=order)!=sorted(manifest['sourceContents'],key=order):raise RuntimeError('Full492 map/source lineage differs')
    for relative,pin in expected:
        if relative.endswith('.js'):
            text=regular(setup/'compiled'/relative).decode()
            for target in re.findall(r'[#@]\s*sourceMappingURL=([^\s]+)',text):
                if '://' in target or target.startswith('data:'):raise RuntimeError('Unexpected external/inline map')
                resolved=(setup/'compiled'/pathlib.Path(relative).parent/target).resolve()
                if not resolved.is_relative_to(setup/'compiled') or not resolved.is_file():raise RuntimeError('Copied map URL broken')
    # Exact accepted manifest and receipts are copies, NEVER rewritten as a new build.
    put(setup/'kernel-compiled-manifest.json',raw_manifest)
    for name,pin in manifest['supervisedBuildReceipts']:put(setup/name,checked(old/name,pin))
    for name in ['bundle-copy-manifest.json','qualified-browser-receipt.json','current-build-qualification.json']:put(setup/name,regular(old/name))
    put(setup/'run-render-kernel-compact-json.mjs',runner)
    put(setup/'kernel-program-attribution-hook.mjs',regular(research/'kernel-program-attribution-hook.mjs'))
    owner="import pathlib,sys,json,os\npid=int(sys.argv[1]);s=pathlib.Path(f'/proc/{pid}/stat').read_text();fields=s[s.rfind(')')+2:].split()\nwith pathlib.Path('wrapper-owner.pending.json').open('x') as f:json.dump({'pid':pid,'starttime':fields[19],'ppid':int(fields[1]),'pgrp':int(fields[2])},f)\nos.link('wrapper-owner.pending.json','wrapper-owner.json');os.unlink('wrapper-owner.pending.json')\n"
    wrapper=setup/'browser-wrapper.sh'
    text='#!/usr/bin/env bash\nset -euo pipefail\ncd -- '+shlex.quote(str(setup))+"\npython3 - \"$$\" <<'PYOWNER'\n"+owner+"PYOWNER\nfor ((i=0;i<600;i++)); do\n [[ ! -e STOP ]] || exit 70\n if [[ -e GO ]]; then break; fi\n sleep 0.05\ndone\n[[ -e GO && ! -e STOP ]] || exit 70\ncd -- "+shlex.quote(receipt['browserOnlyCwd'])+'\nexec '+shlex.quote(receipt['actualBrowser'])+' "$@"\n'
    put(wrapper,text.encode());wrapper.chmod(0o700)
    old_receipt_sha=sha(regular(old/'setup-receipt.json'))
    receipt.update({'purpose':'ONE compact-JSON-only repair after preserved aggregate-cap failure; unchanged reused kernel library',
                    'wrapper':str(wrapper),'wrapperSha256':sha(regular(wrapper)),
                    'reusedCompiledManifestSha256':sha(raw_manifest),'serializationRunnerSha256':sha(runner),
                    'codecActualApprovalSha256':codec_sha,'priorFailedEpisode':str(old)})
    dump(setup/'setup-receipt.json',receipt)
    for file,pin in list(checked_inputs.items()):checked(file,pin)
    for relative,pin in receipt['sourceManifest']:
        if pin is None and ((repo/relative).exists() or (repo/relative).is_symlink()):raise RuntimeError('Deleted source reappeared during preparation')
    composite={'inputBeforeAfterPins':checked_inputs,'kind':'compact-json-unchanged-library-reuse-v1','setup':str(setup),'oldSetup':str(old),
     'oldReceiptSha256':old_receipt_sha,'oldCompiledManifestSha256':sha(raw_manifest),'copiedFiles':expected,
     'maps':maps,'mapSourceContents':source_rows,'newRunnerSha256':sha(runner),
     'oldBrowserStatus':'FAILED aggregate32MiB export before candidate measurement','oldFailurePins':failure_pins,
     'oldAcceptedLibraryApprovalPath':str(research/'cloud-render-kernel-texture-repair-actual-build-browser-approval.json'),
     'oldAcceptedLibraryApprovalSha256':sha(regular(research/'cloud-render-kernel-texture-repair-actual-build-browser-approval.json')),
     'codecActualApprovalPath':str(codec_path),'codecActualApprovalSha256':codec_sha,'codecResultSha256':codec_result['proofResultSha256'],
     'actualCodecProcessPath':process_key,'actualCodecProcessSha256':codec['inputs'][process_key],
     'sourceManifest':receipt['sourceManifest'],'buildFiles':receipt['buildFiles'],'mapFiles':receipt['mapFiles'],
     'toolPins':{receipt['nodeExecutable']:receipt['nodeExecutableSha256'],receipt['actualBrowser']:receipt['actualBrowserSha256']},
     'newSetupReceiptSha256':sha(regular(setup/'setup-receipt.json')),'wrapperSha256':sha(regular(wrapper)),
     'buildExecuted':False,'physicsProofExecuted':False,'browserLaunched':False,'oldManifestRewritten':False,
     'validated':True,'browserInvocationRequiresIndependentReview':True}
    dump(setup/'library-reuse-composite.json',composite)
except BaseException as error:
    dump(setup/'reuse-preparation-failure.json',{'setup':str(setup),'error':str(error),'browserLaunched':False})
    raise
